name: ssh-only
description: Inbound SSH only, for a host that serves nothing else, such as a backup puller. No egress rule, so egress stays ACCEPT_ALL.

rules.description: SSH; sshd takes keys only and fail2ban bans brute force
NTP replies; the firewall tracks state for TCP only, so UDP replies need their own rule
Every other inbound TCP; replies to outbound connections pass as established
Every other inbound UDP; DNS from netcup's resolvers passes netcup's fixed rules first
